# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update. Review the documented HarfBuzzSharp enum compatibility changes before upgrading code that uses combining-class or aggregate glyph flag members.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — The misspelled CCC133 member is now CCC132, retaining the numeric value 132. Update source references to use CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — The aggregate Defined mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 for preview consumers. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update and its documented compatibility changes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2...v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)
